correctness.rationale: A signed-permutation chamber argument gives the exact width formula and central section criterion. Spherical latitude disintegration has unit Jacobian and yields exactly two angular apertures, splitting at two verified thresholds. These establish subdensity formulas almost everywhere, strict intermediate conditional monotonicity, and tail independence. Independent marginal angle-count and two known width moments agree, and the code reproduces ten joint-bin checks.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A general scalar width-density coarea formula is not itself a formula for the coupled width/central-section-type measure: it sums over all normal-fan pieces, including pieces carrying different section types. The additional disintegration at the central-section sign boundary and the conditional independence are not consequences of the reported scalar formulas alone. The full 2026 source was inaccessible, so unreported broader coverage remains a real risk.

value.rationale: This is a complete geometric joint law for two natural stereological observables, not a restatement of either marginal distribution. It establishes a sharp forbidden triangle-section width interval and an upper interval (over 80 percent orientation mass) of exact conditional independence, with a rigorously monotone transition. These structural phase distinctions are useful for understanding what central sections reveal about projection widths.
